title: A smoother exit
changes: Idle windows close directly without re-entering the Closing event.
Active downloads finish cancellation after the window is hidden, preserving resume data.
Online content requests are cancelled on exit; transfer I/O stays off the UI thread.

title: An always-current library
changes: File catalog and release history now load from GitHub without reinstalling the app.
Refresh controls and a validated offline cache for both content sources.
Bundled catalog and release-history files are no longer distributed.

title: GitHub release updates
changes: Automatic update checks now use the public GitHub release repository.
Windows installer and update bundle build workflow.
Resource downloads are paused before applying an application update.

title: A simpler library
changes: Four grouped collections with context-aware category filters.
Episode for client/server files; bit architecture for SQL programs.
Gold pill buttons and download controls that appear only when needed.
Full release history with a slim gold scrollbar.

title: A download library built to resume
changes: Browse catalog files by category, episode and language.
Pause and resume downloads, including after restarting the app.
Progress, saved transfer state and optional SHA-256 verification.
Fixed-size workspace with paged lists instead of scrollbars.

title: Resource collections & release history
changes: Active navigation icons now use the app's gold accent.
Four resource collections with local file selection and file details.
Release history is loaded from a bundled JSON file.
Added the melihxcode copyright footer.

title: A personal touch
changes: New sword and code-bracket application icon.
Contact Me form connected to Formspree.
YouTube, GitHub and website shortcuts.

title: The first workspace
changes: Frameless desktop window with dark styling and four navigation pages.
Version display and configurable Velopack update support.
